about_short_description.short_description: Kastle helps mortgage lenders by automating labor-intensive procedures.

product.name: Kastle AI Platform
product.description: An enterprise AI automation platform for consumer lending and mortgage servicing that handles borrower interactions and workflows across voice, SMS, email, chat, and APIs.

product.name: Mortgage Lending AI Agents
product.description: AI agents that automate borrower and prospect communications during the mortgage lending process, including loan inquiries, information requests, outreach, and workflow support.

product.name: Mortgage Servicing AI Agents
product.description: AI agents for mortgage servicing that answer borrower inquiries, retrieve account and payment information, communicate through multiple channels, and automate routine servicing tasks.

product.name: Collections Agent
product.description: An AI agent that sends payment reminders, engages delinquent borrowers, collects payments, and supports recovery of past-due mortgage accounts.

product.name: Compliance Engine
product.description: A compliance-control layer for mortgage AI and human interactions that applies lending and servicing rules, monitors communications, and produces quality-control scorecards.

product.name: Agent Builder
product.description: A no-code configuration tool for converting lender standard operating procedures into AI agents and updating their workflows using natural-language instructions.
